C-50.IntentSummary: Replace the bare Custom CSS textarea with Tune, My themes and a GitHub gallery. First version is editing only (user 2026-10-15): T-002 and T-003. T-004/T-005 (gallery, import, updates) are deferred to the backlog and not scheduled.

T-001.Title: W1: mockups (Tune, My themes, theme file, Gallery, install dialog) in Paper and Ink

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: User approves the mockups; spec status becomes approved for W2.

T-002.Title: W2a: theme engine — variable registry, sanitiser, ramp derivation, tweaks per member, user themes folder (load, watch, reload), fallback

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Unit tests for registry, sanitiser, ramps, tweaks and fallback; built-in themes unchanged pixel-wise (screenshot diff on Paper/Ink).

T-003.Title: W2b: Tune panel and My themes UI (save as, duplicate, edit file, show in Finder, export, delete with undo; no import); customCss migration to custom.css

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Spec R-1, R-2 (without import), R-5, R-7 met; no network calls; 10 locales; e2e in chromium and webkit.

T-004.Title: DEFERRED (backlog) — W3a: xronocode/mark-themes repository — manifest schema, CI validator (variables, contrast), preview renderer, index.json; seed with the 14 built-in families as examples and 3–5 community-style themes

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A PR with a bad manifest or failing contrast is rejected by CI; index.json is regenerated on merge.

T-005.Title: DEFERRED (backlog) — W3b: Gallery UI, install, daily update check, auto-update setting, import from link; both editions

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Spec R-3, R-4, R-6 met; e2e with a fixture index; live smoke on DMG and App Store builds.
